reason: An offline entertainment plugin that adds a draggable floating DSH panel containing 18 browser-based mini-games, with local score and layout persistence.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中提供包含 18 款离线小游戏的可拖动浮动面板，并保存面板布局与游戏最高分。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable floating DSH Web UI panel with 18 offline mini-games and persists panel layout and high scores locally.

capabilities: Renders 18 offline canvas-based mini-games in a floating DSH Web UI panel
Persists panel layout, position, and game scores in browser localStorage
Uses keyboard, mouse input, and pointer lock for selected gameplay
